title: Benoodle's Carpet to Wool
description: Craft four carpets into one corresponding wool block.
body:
# Features
- Convert colored carpets back into corresponding wool blocks.
- Each recipe uses four carpets to craft one wool blocks.
- Works for all vanilla colors.
# Installation
1. Download the datapack zip.
2. Place it in the datapacks folder of your world.
3. Launch or reload your world to enable the datapack.
# Compatibility
- Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.
